title.narrative: GoodUp CSR Employee Engagement Platform: Go to market Analysis in Kenya and South Africa

description.narrative: GoodUp is a social enterprise that offers a CSR Employee Engagement Platform (software as a service) to manage and promote employee engagement for CSR and philanthropic programs. Such platform contributes to employers in the ‘Battle for Talent’ and help make company’s and employees’ CSR involvement visible, which is becoming increasingly important and in some countries even has become a requirement to be eligible for public procurement. As is the case in for example South Africa, where companies need to demonstrate how they comply with diversity policies and laws such as BBE, for which GoodUp can proof a useful tool. Within 2 years GoodUp has become the Dutch market leader in its field and is now looking to expand its activities to the African continent, in particular to South Africa and Kenya, both rapidly growing markets with rapidly growing ‘Battles for Talent’. In order to develop a bankable business plan for future investments, Technical Assistance (DGGF-TA) provided support to analyse both markets. The project included partners selection, stakeholder interviews to test the viability of the platform and creating awareness and sharing knowledge with more than 200 local partners regarding the importance of visible CSR and employee engagement. As a result, GoodUp is now preparing to expand to South Africa where it will open its first office, which will not only create new jobs but will also enable employers and employee to engage more actively in CSR and philanthropic programs which in turn will positively impact South African (corporate) society.
